# Aumrti — Fact Base

**Every number any Aumrti document is allowed to quote lives here.** Each row is derived from the
repository and should be re-checked against it when it changes, rather than typed from memory. If
a figure appears in a product, marketing or pitch document and is not in this table, it is
unsourced and should be removed.

Measured against the working tree on **2026-09-03**.

> **Why the counting rule matters.** Several of these claims have more than one defensible answer
> because they answer different questions — a module *tile* is not a module *key*, a table in
> migration history is not a table in the live schema. The rule is stated for every row. Quoting a
> number without its rule is what let five documents disagree.

## Notes on the ambiguous rows

**Modules — quote 61.** `CANONICAL_MODULE_KEYS` is what plans grant, what
`ModuleGate` enforces and what a hospital is billed for, so it is the honest answer to "how many
modules do I get". The `/modules` grid renders 67 tiles because several tiles are
views onto one key — the three `/accounts/*` tiles all bill as `accounts`. Both numbers are
true; only one answers a buyer's question.

There is **no `M1..M39` module numbering** anywhere in the codebase. Those identifiers exist only
as prose in `.agents/agents.md` and must not appear in product documentation.

**Tables — quote 555.** That is the live schema as the application sees it. The
568 figure counts every table ever named by a `CREATE TABLE`, including
those since dropped or renamed, and overstates the system.

**AI features — quote both.** 70 are catalogued and individually gateable;
65 resolve to a live call site today. Catalogued but not yet wired to a caller:
`clarifying_questions`, `history_digest`, `history_document_extract`, `tpa_name_resolver`, `voice_asr_engine`. Several of these are invoked server-side through a dedicated edge function rather than
the browser `callAI` path, so "not wired" here means "not reachable through the client helper",
not "not built".

**Source lines — 3,00,761, not 3,54,433.** The larger figure includes
~39,000 lines of generated Supabase types and the test suite. Counting generated code as product
inflates the number without adding anything a hospital can use.

## Open gaps this file is deliberately not hiding

**5 live tables without row-level security:** `ai_feature_classes`, `clinical_reference_sources`, `purchase_requisitions`, `rfqs`, `vendor_quotations`


**Zero live hospital deployments.** No figure in this file is an operational measurement. Every
one is a property of the codebase. Efficiency, time-saved and revenue claims cannot exist until a
pilot hospital produces them, and no Aumrti document may imply otherwise.
